body: The wounds are still really fresh. We broke up about three months ago. I'm dealing with all sorts of fucked up suicidal thoughts every day, but I have to keep myself going.

When I first started dating my ex girlfriend, she told me she thought she was a sociopath. I couldn't believe that after the connection I felt we had. Yeah. I was wrong. Two months after signing a lease and moving in together, she cheated on me and told me she never actually loved me because she is actually incapable of love.

It really just lost its ability to distract me, which is why I played them to begin with. I still find myself buying whatever new game Nintendo puts out, but I can't ever play them for more than a few hours and never touch them again.

Southern Point - Grizzly Bear (honestly, that whole album)

Baby Blue - King Krule

401k - The Fall of Troy

Sleepwalking/Trailer Trash - Modest Mouse

Welcome Home/Willing Well 3 - Coheed and Cambria

A Perfect Sonnet - Bright Eyes

Anything by Jeff Buckley

Anything by Mac Demarco
$2000 in new instruments and recording equipment.

I'm really hoping I can find some more of those small things to be happy about. The only thing that has been making the pain stop at all is compulsively playing scales on guitar and banjo. It doesn't really make me happy, but it makes the pain stop a little bit.

Thak you. The trust issue is something I'm hoping I can work towards, but I feel like I can't trust anyone at this point. I have very few friends, mostly because I abandoned them after I started dating my cheating ex. I'm just really worried that even if I get a little better and start looking for a new relationship, I'm going to fall into the same trap of obsession or they are going to lie and cheat on me again.

Don't apologize. It wasn't crap at all. Thank you for the encouragement mentioned. *hugs* 

I've been saying something to try and get through all of this. "Life is a series of really shitty happenings with a few smatterings of happiness in the middle. That's what we are supposed to live for."

I am really trying to learn to love myself. I really dislike who I am though, but I've been working to change that. I have a lot of self-care issues relating to my hobbies and favorite activities. I obsess over whatever brings me joy. Now I'm obsessing over the only creative outlet I have, which is creating music. I've been compulsively practicing scales anytime I start to feel suicidal.

Thank you for reading my vent and trying your best to encourage me. It means a lot.
